description: This file defines the ModelArmorGuardrail class, implementing guardrail logic for integrating Model Armor API into a FastAPI-based language model application. It includes methods for pre-call, during-call, and post-call hooks, content sanitization, blocking detections, and streaming response processing within a guardrail framework.

classes.name: ModelArmorGuardrail
classes.description: A guardrail class integrating Google Cloud Model Armor for content sanitization and blocking in a language model application. Implements pre-call, moderation, post-call, and streaming hooks to ensure input/output safety.

methods.name: str _get_api_endpoint(self)
methods.description: Constructs and returns the API endpoint URL for Model Armor, defaulting to a regional URL if not explicitly set.

methods.name: dict _create_sanitize_request( self, content: str, source: Literal["user_prompt", "model_response"] )
methods.description: Creates a request payload for Model Armor sanitization API, distinguishing between user prompt and model response sources.

methods.name: str _extract_content_from_response( self, response: Union[Any, ModelResponse] )
methods.description: Extracts text content from ModelResponse objects or returns empty string for non-text responses to skip guardrails.

methods.name: dict make_model_armor_request( self, content: Optional[str] = None, source: Literal["user_prompt", "model_response"] = "user_prompt", request_data: Optional[dict] = None, file_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None, file_type: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a sanitization request to Model Armor API, supporting both text and file inputs, and returns the API response.

methods.name: dict sanitize_file_prompt( self, file_bytes: bytes, file_type: str, source: str = "user_prompt" )
methods.description: Builds a request body for file prompt sanitization, base64-encoding the file bytes and specifying the file type.

methods.name: bool _should_block_content( self, armor_response: dict, allow_sanitization: bool = False )
methods.description: Evaluates Model Armor response indicating whether the content should be blocked based on various filter results and match states.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_sanitized_content(self, armor_response: dict)
methods.description: Retrieves sanitized text data from Model Armor response, prioritizing deidentify results and falling back to root fields.

methods.name: _process_response( self, response: Optional[dict], request_data: dict, start_time: Optional[float] = None, end_time: Optional[float] = None, duration: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Overrides default processing to store only the relevant Model Armor API response and status for logging, avoiding circular references.

methods.name: Union[Exception,str,dict,None] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Pre-invocation hook that sanitizes user inputs before sending to the LLM, potentially blocking content based on Model Armor results.

methods.name: Union[Exception,str,dict,None] async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: During-call hook that attempts to sanitize or block user prompts in real-time during model inference.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )
methods.description: Post-invocation hook that sanitizes model responses after generation, replacing content if necessary.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[ModelResponseStream,None] async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response: Any, request_data: dict, )
methods.description: Processes streaming responses, checking for content violations mid-stream, and sanitizing if enabled.

methods.name: Optional[Type["GuardrailConfigModel"]] get_config_model()
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for the guardrail, used for dynamic configuration.
